metaTitle: Custom Tangle Badge Reels | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom Tangle badge reels in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Durable, retractable badge holders with your logo. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Tangle badge reels are known for their distinctive, tangle-resistant design that keeps ID badges accessible without twisting or knotting. For bulk buyers, these reels offer a practical upgrade over standard badge holders, especially in high-traffic environments like hospitals or warehouses. Customize with your logo using pad printing or embroidery, and choose from multiple color options to match your brand.
heroAltText: Custom Tangle badge reels with retractable cord and logo imprint in assorted colors
